title: Scene It to Believe It: Populate 3D Worlds Quickly With NVIDIA AI Blueprints
description: 3D artists are constantly prototyping. In traditional workflows, modelers must build placeholder, low-fidelity assets to populate 3D scenes, tinkering and adjusting the core elements until they’re in place.
